meta.note: Surface, text, accent and status base values are copied from app/globals.css. Ink, tint, fill and border-strong tokens are mobile additions that keep text at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen background behind lists and cards (web --bg-canvas). Dark is the default theme, matching the web app.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App bars, the bottom tab bar, bottom sheets and the OTP screen (web --bg-surface).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, inputs and dialogs (web --bg-card).

tokens.name: stat
tokens.usage: Ground of KPI tiles such as Cash on Hand and Safekeeping (web --stat-bg).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (web --border-color). Decorative only: below 3:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of text fields, OTP cells and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on card and surface in both themes. Mobile addition.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on canvas, surface, card and stat (14:1 or better) (web --text-color).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as labels, timestamps, OR numbers and helper text, on canvas, surface, card and stat (5.7:1 or better) (web --text-muted).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand sky: icons, the active tab indicator, selection and large display figures (web --accent). Light #0284c7 is 4.1:1 on white, so small accent text uses accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and small accent text on canvas, surface and card (4.8:1 or better). Mobile addition.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Its text is on-accent. Mobile addition: the web's white-on-#0284c7 button is 4.1:1, so light mode deepens it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on accent-fill (8.6:1 dark, 5.9:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row, active chip and the 'Remitted' pill ground; text on it is accent-ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard and switch-access focus ring, offset 2px from the control (3.3:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot and progress fill for settled states: Valid, Verified, Cleared, Settled (web --success). Not a text colour in light mode (2.5:1).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for settled states, on card or success-tint (5.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Valid, Verified, Cleared and Settled pills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status dot for Voided, Invalidated and On Hold (web --danger). Not for small text.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive-action text on card, surface or danger-tint (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Voided and On Hold pills and of error banners.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, as in Void transaction; its text is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger-fill (6.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot for Pending Verification, Unsettled and Active (Unliquidated) (web --warning).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text for pending and unsettled states on card or warning-tint (5.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Pending Verification, Unsettled and Unliquidated pills, and of warning banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status dot for informational states such as Enrolled (web --info).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Informational text on card or info-tint (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of info banners and Enrolled pills.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text of neutral pills (Dropped, Archived, Draft) on neutral-tint.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral pills.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: Quiet zone behind the clearance QR code. White in both themes so phone scanners read it.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR modules on qr-ground (19:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Organization name on the portal and workspace home.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the app bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload your GCash or Maya receipt so an officer can verify it.
styles.usage: Running text, list-row primary text and input values.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary row text, helper text and banners.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field and tile labels. Write the text in sentence case and uppercase it in code.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Pills, tab-bar labels and term chips.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Hero balance on the dashboard and the amount on a receipt.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts in KPI tiles and list rows. Always tabular.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: OR numbers, reference numbers, student IDs and OTP digits at small sizes.

styles.name: otp
styles.usage: Digits inside the six OTP cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines in a list row; pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows with two lines.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of sheets; space above the primary action.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, OTP cells and small buttons (web .form-control is 0.5rem, about 7px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles and list groups (web .card is 0.75rem, about 11px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, term chips and the tab-bar active indicator.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tappable target (Android 48dp; iOS 44pt is covered).

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of full-width primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Height of single-line text fields.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in rows, tabs and buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the floating Record payment button. Cards use a border, not a shadow.
